microscope_slide_preparation.title: Position the microscope slide
microscope_slide_preparation.caption: Lift the glass slide from the open slide box. Set it in the stage guide of the microscope closest to that box, release the slide, then close the slide box. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

incubator_to_biosafety_transfer.title: Transfer the sample dish
incubator_to_biosafety_transfer.caption: Open the lower of the two stacked incubators and lift out the sample dish. Set the dish upright on the work surface inside the biosafety cabinet beside the stack, on the side away from the refrigerator. Release the dish and close the lower incubator. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

centrifuge_balanced_loading.title: Load the centrifuge
centrifuge_balanced_loading.caption: Open the microcentrifuge beside the two tube stands. Take one microtube from each stand, place the two microtubes in opposite sockets in the rotor, release them, and close the lid. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

cloth_remove.title: Remove the microscope cover
cloth_remove.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Lift the cloth covering the microscope beside the cover tray. Lay the cloth in the cover tray and release it.

cloth_replace.title: Replace the microscope cover
cloth_replace.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Start with the cloth in the cover tray. Lift it from the tray and spread it over the optics of the microscope beside the tray. Release the cloth so it stays draped over the optics.

sash_raise.title: Sash raise
sash_raise.caption: Find the biosafety cabinet nearest the refrigerator. Slide its front sash upward and leave it raised. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

notebook_to_drawer.title: Notebook to drawer
notebook_to_drawer.caption: Open the top drawer of the drawer cabinet. Pick up the lab notebook beside the dry bath on the nearest island bench, put it in that drawer, and close the drawer. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

bottle_to_fridge.title: Bottle to fridge
bottle_to_fridge.caption: Open the refrigerator. In the adjacent biosafety cabinet, pick up the culture bottle closest to the refrigerator. Set it on a shelf inside the refrigerator and close the door. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.
